caption: The drawing consists of a detailed technical illustration of a candlestick holder rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a beige or off-white background. The main composition, located at the center, features a side elevation of the candlestick holder, which has a wide base plate, a central stem with bulbous and straight sections, and a circular handle attached to the side. Surrounding the main elevation are smaller technical diagrams: the bottom left shows a top-down view with measurements, the middle lower section shows a partial cross-section and elevation, and the bottom right presents a horizontal cross-section of the handle. The entire composition is made up of clean, precise lines and is contained within a large lightly outlined rectangle, with the technical drawings aligned along the lower edge. The page has no color other than the varied tones of the pencil or ink used for the drawing and light signs of aging on the paper.
title: Candlestick
